summary: Thelia is an open-source e-commerce solution written in PHP and distributed under the LGPL-3.0 licence. It provides a foundational framework for setting up and managing online stores and digital catalogues. Because the official documentation offers few specific details on built-in features, users should expect to configure standard shop capabilities such as product management, cart handling, and payment processing themselves.
goodFor: It is a suitable option if you need an open-source PHP-based e-commerce platform that you can modify under a copyleft licence.
watchOut: The project has a modest community with limited repository stars and overlapping competition from much larger, heavily documented e-commerce platforms, which may impact third-party plugin availability.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, it will typically require a web server like Nginx or Apache, a separate relational database such as MySQL or MariaDB, and persistent storage for uploaded product assets.
